title: Dead or Alive 3
subtitle: A tournament for a new console
summary: Dead or Alive 3 is Team Ninja's fighting game released alongside the Xbox in North America on 15 November 2001. Familiar competitors return to a tournament whose story centres on DOATEC's attempt to turn the captured Genra into a weapon. Hitomi joins the cast, bringing another fighting style into the series. body: Dead or Alive 3 is Team Ninja's fighting game released alongside the Xbox in North America on 15 November 2001. Familiar competitors return to a tournament whose story centres on DOATEC's attempt to turn the captured Genra into a weapon. Hitomi joins the cast, bringing another fighting style into the series. The new hardware gives the fighters and their surroundings more detail, but the immediate attraction remains the exchange between two people: attack, anticipate the response and find the opening before the opponent does.

Strikes, throws and defensive holds form the central contest. A hold can answer an anticipated attack, while a throw punishes an opponent who relies on that defence. Movement around the arena gives another way to change the exchange. Falls and dangerous boundaries can carry a fight into another part of a stage, so position matters alongside the next combination. The player learns to recognise the opponent's habits and vary their own choices, turning a short sequence of attacks into a conversation about what might come next.

The Exercise option in Sparring presents commands on screen and advances after each successful attempt. It offers a practical way to learn a character without searching a move list between every exchange. Japanese and European editions followed in 2002 with additions and adjustments beyond the original North American release. The game sold more than two million copies worldwide and became one of the Xbox's most successful fighting games. Later backward compatibility kept the original release playable on newer Xbox systems, preserving its particular pace and stage design.
